title: How is Qin Shi Huang connected to Kevin Hart?
description:
China's line of emperors, a 1940 handshake, a state visit and three presidents connect Qin Shi Huang to Kevin Hart.

Qin Shi Huang → Puyi → Hirohito → Gerald Ford → Bill Clinton → Barack Obama → Ash Carter → Kevin Hart

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Qin Shi Huang → Puyi (13 portraits, every holder): Qin Shi Huang invented the title of emperor, and China's emperors held it for 2,000 years, down to the last one.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Qin_Shi_Huang.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Liu-bang.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E6%BC%A2%E6%AD%A6%E5%B8%9D.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:TangTaizong.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E5%94%90%E5%90%8E%E8%A1%8C%E5%BE%9E%E5%9C%96_(%E5%B1%80%E9%83%A8)_-_%E6%AD%A6%E5%89%87%E5%A4%A9.png + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Song_Taizu.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:YuanEmperorAlbumKhubilaiPortrait.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_assis_de_l%27empereur_Ming_Taizu.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_assis_de_l%27empereur_Ming_Chengzu.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E6%B8%85%E5%9C%A3%E7%A5%96%E5%BA%B7%E7%86%99%E7%9A%87%E5%B8%9D%E6%9C%9D%E6%9C%8D%E5%83%8F.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E4%B9%BE%E9%9A%86%E7%9A%87%E5%B8%9D%E6%9C%9D%E6%9C%8D%E5%83%8F%E8%BD%B4.png + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E5%85%89%E7%BB%AA%E5%B8%9D.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Puyi,_Manchukuo_period_(cropped).jpg
2. Puyi → Hirohito: In 1940, China's last emperor, by then Japan's puppet ruler in Manchuria, shook hands with Emperor Hirohito.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Emperor_Hirohito_Handshakes_Emperor_Puyi_of_Manchukuo_26_June_1940.png
3. Hirohito → Gerald Ford: In 1975, Hirohito made the first state visit to America by a Japanese emperor, hosted by Gerald Ford.
   Photo by Courtesy Gerald R. Ford Library, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Gerald_Ford_and_Mrs._Betty_Ford_escort_the_Emperor_and_Empress_of_Japan.jpg
4. Gerald Ford → Bill Clinton: In 1997, Ford shared a stage with President Bill Clinton at a presidential library opening in Texas.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Clinton_with_former_presidents_George_H._W._Bush,_Gerald_Ford,_and_Jimmy_Carter_wave_from_the_stage_at_the_dedication_of_the_George_H._W._Bush_Presidential_Library_at_Texa_-_DPLA_-_34dd2e1f15a119c9c93c3b2c42c179f0.jpg
5. Bill Clinton → Barack Obama: At a 2013 White House ceremony, Barack Obama hung the Medal of Freedom around Clinton's neck.
   Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bill_clinton_medal_of_freedom.jpg
6. Barack Obama → Ash Carter: In January 2017, Obama's defense secretary Ash Carter gave him the Pentagon's medal for distinguished public service.
   Photo by Sgt. Amber I. Smith, US Army, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Defense_Secretary_Ash_Carter_awards_the_Honorable_Barack_H._Obama,_44th_President_of_the_United_States,_with_the_Department_of_Defense_Medal_for_Distinguished_Public_Service.jpg
7. Ash Carter → Kevin Hart: At Late Night with Seth Meyers, Ash Carter met Kevin Hart.
   Photo by Ash Carter, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:161013-D-SV709-078_(30012677960).jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
